title: A Colony for the Echo Anew
author: Wendell Dunmore
blurb: Mirabel Whitlock, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
